comments: EqualWeb PDF Accessibility Checker analyzes native and scanned PDF documents, generating detailed accessibility reports before remediation. It supports WCAG compliance evaluation, provides API access upon request, and is trusted by businesses, enterprises, and government organizations worldwide. Available in page-based packages starting from 5 pages.
features: EqualWeb PDF Accessibility Checker analyzes PDF documents and generates a detailed accessibility report before remediation. It identifies accessibility issues, supports WCAG compliance evaluation, and helps organizations prioritize remediation before making documents accessible.
title: PDF Accessibility Checker
